title: KeepSneak
description: Keeps the player sneaking when opening a GUI or menu
body:
## KeepSneak
KeepSneak keeps the player sneaking when opening GUIs or other menus that would normally unsneak you. This lets you do many things while hiding from your enemies. This includes actions such as crafting, chatting, tabbing out, and more! 

The mod is similar to how toggle-sneak works within vanilla Minecraft, but gives the same features to players using hold-to-sneak too!

This mod can be useful for trappers.
